overview: GameBazaar Nepal is a full-stack gaming-themed ecommerce store for digital products. Features a dark neon UI with product catalog (18 items), shopping cart, user auth, order management, and a secure staff admin panel with analytics.
features: Dark neon gaming UI with animated background and floating logo
18 digital products (streaming, gaming, software) priced in NPR
User signup/login with purchase history and order tracking
Shopping cart, checkout, and unique Order ID generation
Secure staff login with backend-verified staff code
Admin panel: order management, payment confirmation, status updates
Sales analytics with revenue charts and order trends
Responsive mobile + desktop design with glassmorphism cards
